summary: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change in independent registered public accounting firm. The board resolved on August 5, 2026, not to reappoint WWC, P.C. and engaged Edston Global PAC effective August 6, 2026. WWC’s audit reports since fiscal 2020 contained no adverse opinions, qualifications, or disagreements. The filing includes WWC’s letter to the SEC consenting to the statements. This is a routine auditor-change disclosure, not a special-situation event. Watch for subsequent audit-related developments or regulatory inquiries, but no transactional or strategic angle is present.
